targets.query:
from(bucket: "explainability")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "shap_base_value" or r._field == "local_score")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "" or "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: if r._field == "local_score" then "local_model_score" else r._field }))
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "_measurement"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "Group"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["source_event_id", "host"])
  |> yield(name: "v1")

from(bucket: "explainability-v2")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability-v2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "shap_base_value" or r._field == "local_score")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "" or "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: if r._field == "local_score" then "local_model_score" else r._field }))
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "_measurement"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "Group"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["source_event_id", "host"])
  |> yield(name: "v2")

fieldSel = if "${feature}" == "" then "ALL" else "${feature}"
groupSel = if "${group}" == "" then "ALL" else "${group}"

ban = ["timestamp","LabviewTime","LabViewTime","StepNumber","Cycle"]

from(bucket: "source-data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "source-data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not contains(value: r._field, set: ban))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => fieldSel == "ALL" or r._field == fieldSel)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => groupSel == "ALL" or r.Group == groupSel)
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "_measurement"])

featureSel = if "${feature}" == "" then "ALL" else "${feature}"

from(bucket: "explainability-shap-diff")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability-shap-diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value_v1" or r._field == "value_v2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "" or "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => featureSel == "ALL" or r.feature == featureSel)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.feature != "")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: if r._field == "value_v1" then "v1" else "v2" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "Group", "feature", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["Group", "feature", "_field"])

featureSel = if "${feature}" == "" then "ALL" else "${feature}"

from(bucket: "explainability-shap-diff")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability-shap-diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "difference")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "" or "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => featureSel == "ALL" or r.feature == featureSel)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.feature != "")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "Group", "feature", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["Group", "feature"])

list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
import "array"

all = array.from(rows: [{_value: "ALL"}])

groups =
  schema.tagValues(
    bucket: "source-data",
    tag: "Group",
    predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "source-data",
    start: 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z,
  )
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

union(tables: [all, groups])
  |> group()

list.definition:
import "array"

all = array.from(rows: [{_value: "ALL"}])

fields =
  from(bucket: "source-data")
    |> range(start: 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "source-data")
    |> keep(columns: ["_field"])
    |> group()
    |> distinct(column: "_field")
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._value != "timestamp" and
      r._value != "LabViewTime" and
      r._value != "LabviewTime" and
      r._value != "StepNumber" and
      r._value != "Cycle"
    )
    |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

union(tables: [all, fields])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"])
